responses.confirm_setup: ✅ Reminder set: in {duration} I'll remind {user} about "{message}"

responses.too_far: A reminder cannot be more than a year away.
responses.cancel_not_found: No reminder #{id} of yours was found (it may have been sent already, or you did not set it).
responses.list_from_others_title: Reminders others set for you (cancel one with /reminder_cancel):

responses.others_not_member: Reminders can only be set for members of this server.

responses.ask_too_often: You have asked people to accept too often lately. Try again in {wait}s.

responses.ask_expired: No answer in time; no reminder was set.
responses.ask_replaced: Replaced by a newer request; this one was not set.
